2.2.1.4. PROBABILISTIC TRACTOGRAPHY. We limited our tractography to delineate tracts that the authors found to correlate
significantly with LBA flexibility. Hence, probabilistic tractography was performed only between right pre-SMA and right
striatum. Here we used the same MNI-space masks for right
pre-SMA and right striatum as were used in Forstmann et al.
(2010). We performed the probabilistic tractography in accordance with the protocol stated in the general methods section
(see above). Resulting tract strength values were corrected for
age and gender using partial correlations, and were subsequently imported into R software for the Bayesian correlation
test. Specifically, we tested for a positive correlation between
right pre-SMAeright striatum tract strength and LBA flexibility.
